review_kind: Complete description-only catalog-stub segment (462 exact pinned packages), individual 10-dimension static candidate reviews; NOT governed review, security scan or behavioral validation
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers each assigned disjoint exact package identities with one shared rubric brief; every SKILL.md and package file read in full at the exact pin; one integration owner validated taxonomy, score/rationale consistency, hard-fail/disposition consistency and exact blob/tree identity, then adjudicated conflicts (see reconciliation_overrides). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: The complete catalog-stub-no-procedure segment (462 paths whose Installation states no source-backed instructions could be extracted) was individually read and graded; none contains an executable procedure, so procedural_clarity, failure_handling and effectiveness_design are 0 for nearly all.

Four stubs carry genuine design prose worth reading as reference (ralph-loop verify-outside-the-worker loop, sandbase evidence-ledger cross-validation, data-master auditable dataset reporting, pangolinfo parser inventory); none is approved for unchanged use.

115 cards show suspected misattribution: the author field names the vendor of the API or a generic monorepo owner (e.g. PostgreSQL credited for audio fingerprinting, Semantic Scholar, Grafana, Pulumi, Intuit) with no evidence that vendor published the card.

79 cards advertise a specific capability (endpoints, auto-fix, auto-assign) that no content supports; many cite whole monorepos (kubernetes, aws-sdk-js-v3, grafana) as the source of a synthetic capability name.

81 cards advertise consequential side effects (deploys, Terraform/OpenTofu/Pulumi changes, posting, email, PagerDuty, IaC drift reconciliation, invoice reconciliation) with no authorization step; 20 advertise sending private content (audio, subtitles, documents, workspace data) to third-party APIs.
Upstream project URLs are preserved in each record as discovery leads only; the upstream projects are separate identities and were not reviewed.

reconciliation_overrides.reason: Below the REFERENCE-ONLY floor (10/20) applied consistently with prior tranches; reviewer found no distinctive reference content sufficient to justify an exception
